content.text: {"id": "mm5338a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 40% of sexually active MSM reported insertive anal intercourse at last sexual encounter"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "of these, 25% did not use a condom"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "of these, 25% did not use a condom"}, {"loc": "ocr", "q": "Did not use acondom at last insertive anal intercourse"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "approximately 40% of MSM who had HIV diagnosed for > 12 months did not have sex with a man"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "was significantly less likely with HIV-negative partners and partners of unknown serostatus"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Condom use for insertive anal intercourse was significantly higher with HIV-negative partners than with HIV-positive partners"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "SHAS is a cross-sectional, multisite study aimed at supplementing information routinely collected in HIV/AIDS surveillance."}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Differences in behavior by partner type were evaluated by using the chi-square test (p<0.05)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "in analyses stratified by partner serostatus, percentages, odds ratios, confidence intervals, and statistical levels of significance were computed."}, {"loc": "ocr", "q": "Statistically differant from referent group (p<0.001)"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
